block.goal: Reduce BitField's implementation by delegating long- and primitive-specific operations to BitFieldSupport while preserving the original BitField API (thin instance wrappers).

inputs: src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/BitField.java: public long setBoolean(final long holder, final boolean flag)
src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/BitField.java: public long setValue(final long holder, final long value)
src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/BitField.java: public byte setByteBoolean(final byte holder, final boolean flag)
src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/BitField.java: public short setShortBoolean(final short holder, final boolean flag)
src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/BitField.java: public short setShortValue(final short holder, final short value)
ops.details: Replace the moved implementations in BitField with thin delegating wrappers that call into BitFieldSupport's static methods. Preserve BitField's public API so callers are unaffected. For example, the long constructor remains but delegates any computation (if necessary) to BitFieldSupport; long instance methods call BitFieldSupport methods passing this.mask and this.shiftCount. Byte/short wrapper methods delegate to BitFieldSupport as well. This keeps BitField's API stable while significantly reducing its number of implementation lines and responsibilities.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
